ARG DEPENDENCY_PROXY
FROM ${DEPENDENCY_PROXY:-}ubuntu:24.04

ENV TZ=Europe/Berlin

# Accept proxy argument
ARG HTTP_PROXY
ENV HTTP_PROXY=${HTTP_PROXY}

# Optional: also set HTTPS_PROXY if needed
ARG HTTPS_PROXY
ENV HTTPS_PROXY=${HTTPS_PROXY}

ARG ROOT=''

WORKDIR /app

ENV PYTHON_VERSION=3.12
ENV PIP_CONFIG_FILE=/app/pip.conf
ENV PIP_CACHE_DIR=/cache/pip
ENV TORCH_HOME=/cache/torch

COPY $ROOT/ /app/
COPY dist/ /dist/

RUN if [ -n "$HTTP_PROXY" ]; then \
        echo "Acquire::http::Proxy \"$HTTP_PROXY\";" > /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/01proxy; \
    fi && \
    if [ -n "$HTTPS_PROXY" ]; then \
        echo "Acquire::https::Proxy \"$HTTPS_PROXY\";" >> /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/01proxy; \
    fi &&\
    chmod +x /app/docker-entrypoint.sh &&\
    mv /app/docker-entrypoint.sh /docker-entrypoint.sh &&\
    mkdir -p /data &&\
    chmod ugo+rw /app -R &&\
    export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive &&\
    echo "Update repo" &&\
    apt-get -yy update &&\
    echo "Install packages" &&\
    apt-get -yy install --no-install-recommends \
        tzdata \
        git \
        ffmpeg \
        portaudio19-dev \
        curl \
        autossh \
        gosu \
        gpg \
        gcc \
        gosu \
        libpq-dev \
        python${PYTHON_VERSION} \
        python3-pip \
        python3-dev \
        python-is-python3 \
    && \
    ln -sf /usr/share/zoneinfo/$TZ /etc/localtime && \
    echo $TZ > /etc/timezone && \
    echo "Cleanup" &&\
    apt-get clean &&\
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* &&\
    \
    echo "Install" &&\
    pip install uv &&\
    uv lock --preview -v &&\
    uv sync -v &&\
    mv .venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/web_service/ui . &&\
    rm -rf /dist

VOLUME /data

EXPOSE 8090

ENTRYPOINT ["/docker-entrypoint.sh"]

CMD ["start"]
